nodes.label: graphify-out/ Prebuilt Graph Output
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: The graph artifacts live in graphify-out/ as GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.html and graph.json; all three must be fresh after an update.

nodes.label: graphify . --update (Incremental Graph Update)
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: Every change to code or documentation must be recorded in graphify before the task is finished; the command is incremental and re-extracts only changed files, so the cost of running it is low compared to letting the graph drift stale.

nodes.label: Gun Game (Mobile Shooter Project)
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: The project is a gun/shooter game targeting mobile devices; this single fact drives the touch-first interaction rules (touch scrolling, no hover) that follow.

nodes.label: Headroom Context Management
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: For long sessions, check headroom_stats mid-task and run headroom_compress proactively rather than waiting for the session to slow down; headroom_retrieve restores compressed content.

nodes.label: UI Color Theme (Black, Red, Golden Yellow)
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.norm_label: ui color theme (black, red, golden yellow)
nodes.rationale: The app UI predominantly uses black, red and golden-yellow; new screens and widgets are expected to stay inside this palette for visual consistency.

nodes.label: assets/ Exclusion from the Graph
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: Image and audio files under assets/ are excluded from the graph because they are game assets and carry no structural information about the codebase.

nodes.label: Context Preservation Principle
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: A cross-cutting principle uniting the graphify-first rule, headroom compression, and the image-processing policy: keep expensive raw material (file dumps, images, long histories) out of the context window and reach for a compact derived representation instead.

nodes.label: Graph Update Significance Threshold
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: Trivial single-file edits (e.g. changing one number) do not warrant an update, but any new file, new function, new handler, or file deletion must be registered — the threshold exists so the graph stays structurally accurate without paying update cost for noise.

nodes.label: Graphify-First Structural Query Policy
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: Any task requiring understanding of project structure (locating a file, module relationships, architecture, 'where is X defined') must start as a graphify query rather than repeated Read/Grep, because the graph is already built and answers structural questions far cheaper than sequential file reads. Direct file reading is the fallback only when the graph fails to answer.

nodes.label: Headroom Desktop-App Proxy Limitation (issue #869)
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: Headroom only works in sessions launched from a terminal; desktop-app sessions bypass the proxy because the desktop client overwrites ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (issue #869). In the desktop app headroom_compress is a no-op and /compact must be used instead; state can be checked with headroom_stats or headroom doctor.

nodes.label: Image Processing via Python Script, Not Context
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.norm_label: image processing via python script, not context
nodes.rationale: To extract information from an image (e.g. deriving obstacles from a map), never load the image into context — write a Python script emitting JSON using the installed opencv, numpy, pillow and scipy, and persist the result to disk so it survives a compact.

nodes.label: No Hover State Rule
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.rationale: Hover does not exist on a touch screen, so no UI affordance may depend on a hover state; interactions must be expressed through pressed/selected states instead.

nodes.label: Touch Scroll Requirement for Scrollable Areas
nodes.community_name: Row Sheet UI Asset Preview Page
nodes.norm_label: touch scroll requirement for scrollable areas
nodes.rationale: Anywhere a scrollbar is added, the user must be able to drag the content up/down with touch, because a mobile player has no mouse wheel and a thin scrollbar thumb is not a reliable touch target.
